title: coord serve serves the committed policy and the group overrides as two OPA bundles that answer 304 when unchanged
goal: coord.py serve --policy-dir DIR answers GET /v1/bundles/kbjobs.tar.gz (DIR's .rego and data files, manifest roots kbjobs/placement and kbjobs/groups) and GET /v1/bundles/kbjobs-overrides.tar.gz (data.json under kbjobs/overrides, mapping each group path to its override, manifest root kbjobs/overrides), both behind the same bearer check as POST /v1/run, each with an ETag that changes only with its content and 304 for a matching If-None-Match; a missing --policy-dir answers 404 for the first bundle only

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
kd=os.path.join(d,"keys")
def key(p,t):
    f=os.path.join(kd,*p.split("/")); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f),exist_ok=True); open(f,"w").write(t); os.chmod(f,0o600); return f
import urllib.request,urllib.error,tarfile,io
a=key("corp/ops/jan.kowalski","ka-placeholder"); pd=os.path.join(d,"pol"); os.makedirs(pd); open(os.path.join(pd,"placement.rego"),"w").write("package kbjobs.placement\n")
EXTRA=["--policy-dir",pd]
sv=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--store",os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"),"serve","--bind","127.0.0.1:0","--keys",kd]+EXTRA,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
url=sv.stdout.readline().split("serving")[1].strip()
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--url",url,"--key-file",a,"put","group/corp/ops/policy/placement","--value",json.dumps({"check":{"executor":"server"}}),"--revision","0"],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
def get(p,h={}):
    try:
        r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url+p,headers=h),timeout=30); return r.status,r.headers.get("ETag"),r.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code,None,b""
au={"Authorization":" ".join(["Bearer",open(a).read()])}
s0,_,_=get("/v1/bundles/kbjobs-overrides.tar.gz")
s1,e1,b1=get("/v1/bundles/kbjobs-overrides.tar.gz",au); s2,_,_=get("/v1/bundles/kbjobs-overrides.tar.gz",dict(au,**{"If-None-Match":e1}))
s3,_,b3=get("/v1/bundles/kbjobs.tar.gz",au); sv.terminate()
t=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(b1)); names=t.getnames(); data=json.loads(t.extractfile([n for n in names if n.endswith("kbjobs/overrides/data.json")][0]).read())
assert (s0,s1,s2,s3)==(401,200,304,200), (s0,s1,s2,s3)
assert data["corp/ops"]["check"]["executor"]=="server", data
assert any(n.endswith("placement.rego") for n in tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(b3)).getnames())

notes: Research 2026-11-08: OPA bundle manifest roots, resource default bundles/<name>, Etag/304, bearer token_path, ${NAME} substitution only under opa run and only for defined variables, persistence_directory default $PWD/.opa, and test discovery by the test_ prefix are in kb public/agents/policy-as-code.md (QK-operations-placement-stories-need-opa-bundles).
